newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico livestock report, feeder export price - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Mexico livestock report, feeder export price - USDA.

text.p: USDA reported Friday that around 4,100 head were exported into the United States at four crossing points Thursday.

Through Santa Teresa, N.M., around 2,900 steer calves were sold at prices 1 cent/lb lower compared to Wednesday. "Trade moderate, demand moderate. Bulk of supply consisted of steers weighing 300-500 lb," the USDA said.
Prices for head weighing 300-400 lb were 90-100 cents/lb and for 400-500 lb head at 80-90 cents/lb.

Through Nogales, Ariz., around 1,000 head were sold at steady prices for steer calves, the USDA said. Prices were 90-100 cents/lb for head weighing 300-400 lb and for 400-500 lb head they were 80-90 cents/lb.
Through Laredo and Del Rio, Texas, around 100 head were sold at both crossing points at mostly steady prices, although there was not enough trade to establish trend prices.
